properties.description: The medallion lake, as seen from Synapse Studio. Lets analysts browse raw/ and curated/ in the Data hub and right-click a Parquet file to generate an OPENROWSET query, which is by far the fastest way to onboard someone to the lake. Runtime queries do NOT go through this linked service - they go through the EXTERNAL DATA SOURCEs in src/synapse/serverless/030_external_data_sources.sql - so a mistake here breaks the browsing experience, not the pipeline. Managed-identity auth; `url` is rewritten per environment by deployment/config-<env>.csv.
